module_summary: UART transmitter with state machine controlling timing via baud counter and serializing data.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: Main state controller: IDLE, START, DATA, STOP states driving tx_o and bit operations.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Request to transmit input handshake signal.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready output handshake: asserted when in IDLE state.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: 8-bit input data payload to be transmitted.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial output bit driven by FSM state and shift register LSB.

anchors.name: baud_cnt_q
anchors.why: 4-bit baud rate counter incrementing each cycle until CLK_DIV.

anchors.name: baud_tick
anchors.why: Signals when baud counter reaches CLK_DIV-1; gates FSM transitions and counter reset.

anchors.name: bit_idx_q
anchors.why: 3-bit counter tracking bit position (0-7) during DATA state.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register holding transmit data; right-shifted each baud tick in DATA.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Output status: asserted when not in IDLE state.

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: Main state machine controlling transmit sequence through 4 states.

groups.name: Baud Timing
groups.description: Baud rate counter and tick signal for synchronizing state transitions.

groups.name: Serializer
groups.description: Bit counter and shift register for serializing 8-bit data output.

groups.name: External Interface
groups.description: Handshake ports (tx_valid/tx_ready), data ports (tx_data/tx_o), and busy status.
